items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You had Jimmy Cheatham, Tom MacIntosh on trombone, and then two saxophones, Steve Potts and Arnie Lawrence.

ctx.x: Well he graduated and came to New York and we’ve been together ever since. That’s about 15 years ago. That’s Jeff Kaye, my manger now. And he’s the last word. If he doesn’t want to work, I won’t work. And I’m his only client. I mean he runs his family business. They make truck bodies. They’re in Indiana and he’s dynamite, man. We’re family, you know and here again man, I got lucky.

So, yeah, you talked about this group. You had Jimmy Cheatham, Tom MacIntosh on trombone, and then two saxophones, Steve Potts and Arnie Lawrence. But you know there was a very similar recording made before that, The Dealer.
Oh, yeah, where I introduced Larry Coryell, yeah.
